scope: For each fixed nonempty countable log-syndetic family and 0 < epsilon < 1, one large-measure closed nowhere-dense periodic set works simultaneously for all positive real leading powers, positive power-remainder rates, signed nonzero coefficients, translations and functions with the eventual power bound; every positive input tail has infinitely many distinct output values outside it. The family precedes the set. A compact corollary is included.
